تشترعي (form VIII)
# تَشْتَرِعِي (taštariʕī) /taʃ.ta.ri.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# تُشْتَرَعِي (tuštaraʕī) /tuʃ.ta.ra.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
